beats.boundaryReason: The party explores the entry room, chapel, and first door-routing clues until climbing to a new room that is not the one they expected.
dateEvidence: This beat continues immediately after entering the 27th Room on 1740-10-05.

beats.title: The First Journal
beats.boundaryReason: A second mechanical room introduces the iron window, journal, automatic writing, and cold-iron theories, ending when the party chooses room 16.
dateEvidence: This beat continues the uninterrupted evening exploration.
No long rest or other date-changing event occurs in this range.

beats.title: Mapping to Rest
beats.boundaryReason: The party tests room connections through several numbered rooms, returns to the chapel, and ends the sequence by taking a long rest.
dateEvidence: This beat continues the same evening exploration sequence on 1740-10-05.
The party explicitly returns to the chapel and decides to rest for 8 hours.
The DM calls for a long rest before the next beat resumes at the end of it.

beats.title: Pattern and Dreamer
beats.boundaryReason: At the end of the long rest, Menestheus identifies a room-rotation pattern, then room 15 reveals a second mechanical-room window and the Dreamer notebook.
dateEvidence: This beat begins explicitly at the end of the long rest.
The session metadata end date and long-rest transition support 1740-10-06.

beats.title: Kalepsis and the Key
beats.boundaryReason: The party enters room 18, meets Kalepsis, learns about the prison, infection, room rotation, and the glass key, and the in-character scene closes before the table calls the session.
dateEvidence: This beat continues directly after the post-rest morning exploration.
No additional rest or date transition occurs before the end of the in-character scene.

beats.title: Postgame Maze Debrief
beats.boundaryReason: The session shifts from play into an out-of-character decision to stop, followed by discussion of the rotating-room puzzle, mapping clues, and next-session recap needs.
dateEvidence: This beat follows the same session night after the long-rest transition to 1740-10-06.
The content is out-of-character debrief rather than a new in-world day.
